```{r}
#Graph one State Variables Evolution
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(tidyverse)

#I defined my compartment for my SEHMCR model
malpractice_model <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    
    dS <- Lambda  + omega * H - beta * S * M- mu * S
    dE <- beta * S * M - (tau + sigma + mu) * E
    dM <- sigma * E - (mu + alpha + delta) * M
    dC <- alpha * M - (mu + gamma) * C
    dR <- gamma * C + delta * M - (epsilon + mu) * R
    dH <- tau * E + epsilon * R - omega * H - mu * H
    
    return(list(c(dS, dE, dM, dC, dR, dH)))
  })
}

#  I set my Parameters with inital conditions which was derived from \citep{konlan2025} beta and gamma were assumed
params <- c(Lambda = 50.0, mu = 0.0005, beta = 0.6, omega = 0.9,
            tau = 0.5, sigma = 0.0044, alpha = 0.15, delta = 0.15,
            gamma = 0.3, epsilon = 0.3)

# Initial values from \citep{konlan2025} + Assumed E(0) for your work
initial_state <- c(S = 120, E = 30, M = 25, C = 5, R = 5, H = 15)

# Solve the system for 6 years 
times <- seq(0, 5, by = 0.05)
out <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial_state, times = times, func = malpractice_model, parms = params))

# other functions to help in plotting 
plot_subpop <- function(data, var, color, title, ylab) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = "time", y = var)) +
    geom_line(color = color, size = 1.2) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Time (Years)", y = ylab) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
}

# Individual state variable evolution is generated 
p2 <- plot_subpop(out, "S", "red", "Evolution of Susceptible Individuals", "Susceptible Individuals")
p1 <- plot_subpop(out, "E", "yellow", "Evolution of Exposed Individuals", "Exposed Individuals")
p3 <- plot_subpop(out, "M", "green", "Evolution of Malpractice Individuals", "Malpractice Individuals")
p4 <- plot_subpop(out, "C", "black", "Evolution of Cancelled Individuals", "Cancelled Individuals")
p5 <- plot_subpop(out, "R", "cyan", "Evolution of Recovered Individuals", "Recovered Individuals")
p6 <- plot_subpop(out, "H", "blue", "Evolution of Honest Individuals", "Honest Individuals")

# 6. Combining Plot for easy access
p7 <- ggplot(out, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = S, color = "Susceptible")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = E, color = "Exposed")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = M, color = "Engaging")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = C, color = "Cancelled")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = R, color = "Recovered")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = H, color = "Honest")) +
  labs(title = "Evolution of Population Sub-Classes", x = "Time (Years)", y = "Populations") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Susceptible"="red", "Exposed"="yellow", "Engaging"="green", 
                               "Cancelled"="black", "Recovered"="cyan", "Honest"="blue")) +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# Individual plots to be displayed
print(p2) # Fig 2
print(p3) # Fig 3
print(p4) # Fig 4
print(p5)#Fig 5
print(p6) #Fig 6
print(p1)#Fig 1
```

```{r}
#for the optimal control plots
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(tidyverse)

# 
malpractice_control <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    # w1, w2, w3 are the controls (0 to 1)
    dS <- Lambda + omega*H- (1-w1)*beta*S*M  - mu*S
    dE <- (1-w1)*beta*S*M - (tau + w2 + sigma + mu)*E
    dM <- sigma*E - (mu + alpha + w3 + delta)*M
    dC <- (alpha + w3)*M - (mu + gamma)*C
    dR <- gamma*C + delta*M - (epsilon + mu)*R
    dH <- (tau + w2)*E + epsilon*R - mu*H- omega*H 
    
    return(list(c(dS, dE, dM, dC, dR, dH)))
  })
}

# initial values of Parameters 
params_base <- c(Lambda = 50.0, mu = 0.0005, beta = 0.6, omega = 0.9,
                 tau = 0.5, sigma = 0.0044, alpha = 0.15, delta = 0.15,
                 gamma = 0.3, epsilon = 0.3, w1=0, w2=0, w3=0)

# Optimal Control Parameters 
params_opt <- params_base
params_opt[c("w1", "w2", "w3")] <- 0.5

# Initial state and time (6 years)
init <- c(S = 120, E = 30, M = 25, C = 5, R = 5, H = 15)
times <- seq(0, 5, by = 0.05)

# Simulate
out_base <- as.data.frame(ode(y = init, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_base))
out_opt <- as.data.frame(ode(y = init, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_opt))

# Plotting Comparison for Engaging Class (M)
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=out_base, aes(x=time, y=M, color="No Control"), size=1.2) +
  geom_line(data=out_opt, aes(x=time, y=M, color="Optimal Control"), linetype="dashed", size=1.2) +
  labs(title="Impact of Optimal Control on Malpractice Engagement",
       subtitle="Visualizing stability and control efficacy",
       x="Time (Years)", y="Students Engaging in Malpractice (M)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Defining the Controlled ODE System 
malpractice_control <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    # w1: Preventive, w2: Detective, w3: Corrective
    dS <- Lambda - (1-w1)*beta*S*M + omega*H - mu*S
    dE <- (1-w1)*beta*S*M - (tau + w2 + sigma + mu)*E
    dM <- sigma*E - (mu + alpha + w3 + delta)*M
    dC <- (alpha + w3)*M - (mu + gamma)*C
    dR <- gamma*C + delta*M - (epsilon + mu)*R
    dH <- (tau + w2)*E + epsilon*R - omega*H - mu*H
    return(list(c(dS, dE, dM, dC, dR, dH)))
  })
}

 
#initial values of Parameters 
params_base <- c(Lambda = 50.0, mu = 0.0005, beta = 0.6, omega = 0.9,
                 tau = 0.5, sigma = 0.0044, alpha = 0.15, delta = 0.15,
                 gamma = 0.3, epsilon = 0.3, w1=0, w2=0, w3=0)

# 50% Control Intensity 
params_opt <- params_base
params_opt[c("w1", "w2", "w3")] <- 0.5

initial_state <- c(S = 120, E = 30, M = 25, C = 5, R = 5, H = 15)
times <- seq(0, 5, by = 0.05)

# 3. Simulate both scenarios
out_no_ctrl <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial_state, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_base))
out_opt_ctrl <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial_state, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_opt))

# 4. Visualization for Exposed (E) Compartment
p_exposed <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=out_no_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=E, color="No Control"), size=1.2) +
  geom_line(data=out_opt_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=E, color="Optimal Control"), linetype="dashed", size=1.2) +
  labs(title="Comparison of Exposed Sub-population (E)", x="Time (Years)", y="Number of Exposed Students") +
  theme_minimal()

# 5. Visualization for Cancelled (C) Compartment
p_cancelled <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=out_no_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=C, color="No Control"), size=1.2) +
  geom_line(data=out_opt_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=C, color="Optimal Control"), linetype="dashed", size=1.2) +
  labs(title="Comparison of Cancelled Results (C)", x="Time (Years)", y="Students with Cancelled Results") +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_exposed)
print(p_cancelled)
```

```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Defining the Controlled ODE System 
malpractice_control <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    # w1: Preventive, w2: Detective, w3: Corrective
    dS <- Lambda - (1-w1)*beta*S*M + omega*H - mu*S
    dE <- (1-w1)*beta*S*M - (tau + w2 + sigma + mu)*E
    dM <- sigma*E - (mu + alpha + w3 + delta)*M
    dC <- (alpha + w3)*M - (mu + gamma)*C
    dR <- gamma*C + delta*M - (epsilon + mu)*R
    dH <- (tau + w2)*E + epsilon*R - omega*H - mu*H
    return(list(c(dS, dE, dM, dC, dR, dH)))
  })
}

# 2. Parameters and Initial Conditions 
params_base <- c(Lambda = 50.0, mu = 0.0005, beta = 0.6, omega = 0.9,
                 tau = 0.5, sigma = 0.0044, alpha = 0.15, delta = 0.15,
                 gamma = 0.3, epsilon = 0.3, w1=0, w2=0, w3=0)

# Scenario: 50% Control Intensity for Optimal Control
params_opt <- params_base
params_opt[c("w1", "w2", "w3")] <- 0.5

initial_state <- c(S = 120, E = 30, M = 25, C = 5, R = 5, H = 15)
times <- seq(0, 6, by = 0.05)

# 3. Solve for both scenarios
out_no_ctrl <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial_state, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_base))
out_opt_ctrl <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial_state, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_opt))

# 4. Graph 1: Comparison for Exposed (E) Compartment
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=out_no_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=E, color="No Control"), size=1.2) +
  geom_line(data=out_opt_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=E, color="Optimal Control"), linetype="dashed", size=1.2) +
  labs(title="Comparison of Exposed Sub-population (E)", 
       subtitle="Impact of Preventive (w1) and Detective (w2) Controls",
       x="Time (Years)", y="Exposed Students") +
  theme_minimal()

# 5. Graph 2: Comparison for Cancelled (C) Compartment
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=out_no_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=C, color="No Control"), size=1.2) +
  geom_line(data=out_opt_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=C, color="Optimal Control"), linetype="dashed", size=1.2) +
  labs(title="Comparison of Cancelled Results (C)", 
       subtitle="Impact of Corrective Control (w3)",
       x="Time (Years)", y="Students with Cancelled Results") +
  theme_minimal()
```




```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Defining the Controlled ODE System 
malpractice_control <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    # w1: Preventive, w2: Detective, w3: Corrective
    dS <- Lambda - (1-w1)*beta*S*M + omega*H - mu*S
    dE <- (1-w1)*beta*S*M - (tau + w2 + sigma + mu)*E
    dM <- sigma*E - (mu + alpha + w3 + delta)*M
    dC <- (alpha + w3)*M - (mu + gamma)*C
    dR <- gamma*C + delta*M - (epsilon + mu)*R
    dH <- (tau + w2)*E + epsilon*R - omega*H - mu*H
    return(list(c(dS, dE, dM, dC, dR, dH)))
  })
}

# 2. Parameters and Initial Conditions
params_base <- c(Lambda = 50.0, mu = 0.0005, beta = 0.6, omega = 0.9,
                 tau = 0.5, sigma = 0.0044, alpha = 0.15, delta = 0.15,gamma = 0.3, epsilon = 0.3, w1=0, w2=0, w3=0)

# Scenario: 50% Control Intensity (w1, w2, w3 = 0.5)
params_opt <- params_base
params_opt[c("w1", "w2", "w3")] <- 0.5

initial_state <- c(S = 120, E = 30, M = 25, C = 5, R = 5, H = 15)
times <- seq(0, 6, by = 0.05)

# 3. Here we Solve for No Control and Optimal Control
out_no_ctrl <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial_state, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_base))
out_opt_ctrl <- as.data.frame(ode(y = initial_state, times = times, func = malpractice_control, parms = params_opt))


# 4. This is for the Graphing: Comparison for Honest (H) Compartment
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=out_no_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=H, color="No Control"), size=1.2) +
  geom_line(data=out_opt_ctrl, aes(x=time, y=H, color="Optimal Control"), linetype="dashed", size=1.2) +
  labs(title="Comparison of Honest Student Population (H)", 
       subtitle="Impact of Detective (w2) and Corrective (w3) Controls",
       x="Time (Years)", y="Number of Honest Students") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No Control" = "darkgreen", "Optimal Control" = "blue"))
```


```{r}
#For the sensitivity Analysis
sensitivity_indices <- function(p) {
  sig <- p["sigma"]; tau <- p["tau"]; mu <- p["mu"]
  alp <- p["alpha"]; del <- p["delta"]
  A <- sig + tau + mu;  B <- alp + del + mu
  c(
    beta   =  1,
    Lambda =  1,
    sigma  =  B / (A + B),
    tau    = -tau / A,
    alpha  = -alp / B,
    delta  = -del / B,
    mu     = -1 - mu/A - mu/B
  )
}

si <- sensitivity_indices(params)
si_df <- data.frame(
  param = names(si),
  index = as.numeric(si),
  direction = ifelse(as.numeric(si) > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
)

ggplot(si_df, aes(x = reorder(param, index), y = index, fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "steelblue", "Negative" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(title = "Sensitivity indices of R0",
       x = "Parameter", y = "Normalised sensitivity index",
       fill = "Impact") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
